say:1:1422306001:1.text: Mother! Some people are here to see us!
say:1:1422306001:1.source_cn: 妈妈，有魔法师和仓鼠使魔来看我们了！
say:1:1422306001:1.male: Mother! Some people are here to see us!
say:1:1422306001:1.female: Mother! Some people are here to see us!

say:2:1422306002:1.source_cn: 他们还帮我们把火鸡赶了回来！

say:3:1422306003:1.text: Tali... Oh, they really are back!
say:3:1422306003:1.source_cn: 塔莉……你又……哎，火鸡真的飞回来了！

say:4:1422306004:1.text: So, you're Tali's guests... Apologies, I thought it was one of Tali's fantasies again...
say:4:1422306004:1.source_cn: 你们就是塔莉说的……客人？抱歉，我还以为塔莉又在幻想……

say:5:1422306005:1.text: Children always say fantastical things like how little lambs and hamsters could talk...
say:5:1422306005:1.source_cn: 小孩子嘛，总会说一些不切实际的话，比如小羊和仓鼠会说话...

say:7:1422306006:1.text: Well, Tali isn't lying this time. You just met the friendliest mage in Esperia!
say:7:1422306006:1.source_cn: 这次塔莉可没说错，你们确实遇到了好心的魔法师！
say:7:1422306006:1.male: Well, Tali isn't lying this time. You just met the friendliest mage in Esperia!
say:7:1422306006:1.female: Well, Tali isn't lying this time. You just met the friendliest mage in Esperia!

say:8:1422306007:1.source_cn: 这……！我今天是不是睡昏头了……

say:9:1422306008:1.text: So, our magister is a member of the Arcane Council. Our task is to find people to help and solve their problems. It's a part of our monthly duties.
say:9:1422306008:1.source_cn: ……是这样的，我们的主人是隶属魔法师协会的魔法师，只有...
say:9:1422306008:1.male: So, our magister is a member of the Arcane Council. Our task is to find people to help and solve their problems. It's a part of our monthly duties.
say:9:1422306008:1.female: So, our magister is a member of the Arcane Council. Our task is to find people to help and solve their problems. It's a part of our monthly duties.

say:10:1422306009:1.text: Just like what we did for you, Freda!
say:10:1422306009:1.source_cn: 所以我们需要帮助别人解决烦恼，比如弗瑞达你的！

say:11:1422306010:1.text: How do you know my name?

say:12:1422306011:1.source_cn: 这个……是魔法！……很神奇的魔法！

choice_prompt:13:1422306011.source_cn: 这个……是魔法！……很神奇的魔法！

say:14:1422306012:1.text: Well, it's rare that someone has the time to listen to my troubles. I don't worry much about anything except for... Tali's father.
say:14:1422306012:1.source_cn: ……好吧，真难得有人愿意听我的烦恼。我没别的烦恼，唯独...

say:15:1422306013:1.text: He left the village to find work, and I know how hard he pushes himself. It must be so difficult for him out there. I always make sure to send him letters, letting him know we were okay, and he'd reply as quickly as he could.
say:15:1422306013:1.source_cn: 塔莉的父亲去了村外打拼，工作得废寝忘食，十分辛苦，但我...

say:16:1422306014:1.text: But recently, he hasn't been responding. I'm worried that something happened to him.
say:16:1422306014:1.source_cn: 可我最近寄给他的信，连着几封都没有回音，我担心……他出...

say:18:1422306016:1.text: Apologies if I've said too much... I just wrote a new letter. It'd be great if you can help me deliver it to him. I still need to prepare dinner...
say:18:1422306016:1.source_cn: 抱歉对着你们说了这么多……我刚写了一封新的信想寄给他，...

say:19:1422306017:1.text: Oh, as a thank you, how about we have dinner together tonight? I'll prepare a hearty meal!
say:19:1422306017:1.source_cn: 作为感谢，我邀请你们今晚一起吃晚餐吧，我会准备一顿丰盛...

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 塔莉跟我们提到了你的名字
